business_summary: Lincoln National Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates multiple insurance and retirement businesses in the United States. It operates through four segments: Life Insurance, Annuities, Group Protection, and Retirement Plan Services. The Life Insurance segment provides life insurance products, including term insurance, universal life insurance (UL), indexed universal life insurance, variable universal life insurance (VUL), linked-benefit UL and VUL products, and critical illness and long-term care riders. Its Annuities segment offers variable, fixed, and registered index-linked annuities. The Group Protection segment offers group nonmedical insurance products consisting of short and long-term disability and administration services, statutory disability; paid family medical leave administration and absence management services; term life; life; supplemental health insurance; accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity benefits and dental and vision products to the employer marketplace through various forms of employee-paid and employer-paid plans. Its Retirement Plan Services segment provides employers with retirement plan products and services primarily in the defined contribution retirement plan marketplace; individual and group variable annuities, group fixed annuities, and mutual fund-based programs; and various plan services, including plan recordkeeping, compliance testing, participant education, and trust and custodial services. It distributes its products through consultants, brokers, planners, agents, financial advisors, third-party administrators, financial institutions, and other intermediaries. Lincoln National Corporation was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania.
business_summary_ko: Lincoln National Corporation은 자회사를 통해 미국에서 여러 보험 및 은퇴 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 생명 보험, 연금, 그룹 보호, 퇴직 계획 서비스 등 4개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 생명보험 부문은 정기보험, 유니버셜 생명보험(UL), 지수형 유니버셜 생명보험, 변액 유니버셜 생명보험(VUL), 연계 혜택 UL 및 VUL 상품, 중병 및 장기요양 특약을 포함한 생명보험 상품을 제공합니다. 연금 부문은 가변, 고정 및 등록된 인덱스 연결 연금을 제공합니다. 그룹 보호 부문은 단기 및 장기 장애 및 행정 서비스, 법정 장애로 구성된 그룹 비의료 보험 상품을 제공합니다. 유급 가족 병가 관리 및 결근 관리 서비스; 수명; 삶; 보충 건강 보험; 다양한 형태의 직원 지불 및 고용주 지불 계획을 통해 사고, 중병, 병원 보상 혜택, 치과 및 안과 제품을 고용주 시장에 제공합니다. 퇴직 계획 서비스 부문은 주로 정의된 방식으로 고용주에게 퇴직 계획 제품 및 서비스를 제공합니다.
